    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    is_non_empty = valid & ~is_empty
    scores[is_non_empty] = np.exp(-rem[is_non_empty])
    if np.any(is_empty):
        num_bins = len(bins)
        empty_indices = np.where(is_empty)[0]
        scores[empty_indices[0]] = np.exp(-item * 0.5) * (1.0 - 0.1 * min(num_bins, 5))
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    tight_mask = valid & ~empty_mask
    if np.any(tight_mask):
        scores[tight_mask] = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.power(rem[tight_mask], 2))
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty_idx = np.where(empty_mask)[0][0]
        num_active = np.sum(~empty_mask & (bins < max_cap))
        scores[first_empty_idx] = 0.2 / (1.0 + num_active)
    return scores
